exposure: Close contact with patients during the second stage of labor who may be shedding SARS-CoV-2 via exhalation, coughing, shouting, vomiting
outcome: COVID-19 transmission to labor and delivery personnel
Spread of COVID-19 to other healthcare workers and patients
cohort: This abstract discusses risks and recommendations for labor and delivery personnel.
finding: Labor and delivery personnel face a high risk of COVID-19 transmission during the second stage of labor and should be provided full personal protective equipment (PPE), including N95 respirators.
mod_finding: The second stage of labor, which occurs during vaginal birth, exposes providers to aerosolized particles, elevating their COVID-19 risk.
